description: This file defines the MAX_Plugin_Translation class, which manages plugin translation files, including loading language files, translating strings, and handling translation data for plugins within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: MAX_Plugin_Translation
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing plugin translation files, including initialization, loading language files, and translating strings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Includes plugin translation files based on module, package, and language preferences.

methods.name: includePluginLanguageFile
methods.description: Loads language files for a plugin module and package, merging translations as needed.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a given string key into the target language, with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: lazyInit
methods.description: Ensures translation files are loaded for a given module and package.
